decidedOption: extend the existing workspace panel: identity statement as the lead band, four stance rows carrying the resolver's own rationale, and the change form plus impact preview behind one disclosure

notes.measurementScope: The panel, not the whole page. /workspace carries sweepEligible:false (wall-clock-collection) in apps/web/lib/ux-budget/route-purpose.generated.json, so the rendered route sweep never measures it and it has no row in route-budget-baseline.json. baselineComparison is 'new-route' in that gate's sense — absent from the committed baseline — not a claim that /workspace is a new route.
notes.howMeasured: apps/web/components/workspace/InstallationIdentityPanel.uxbudget.test.tsx renders the panel's heaviest honest arrival state in jsdom and runs lib/ux-budget's measureUxBudget on the resulting DOM, the same code the sweep runs. The test also asserts the cockpit budget at routeStatus 'net-new', so the absolute text budgets are blocking rather than advisory for this surface.
notes.axeCaveat: axe-core 4.12.1 against the jsdom render with color-contrast disabled, because that rule needs real layout and would report 'incomplete' rather than a pass. Token and theme contrast stay covered by the style-drift and primitive-adoption guards.
notes.reading: readingGradeLevel 8, inside the high-school tier the cockpit shell requires.
